chatMembers.read: userId = session.identity.subject or exists chatMembers(chatId = this.chatId, userId = session.identity.subject)

chats.read: isPublic = true or exists chatMembers(chatId = this.id, userId = session.identity.subject) or joinCode = session.claims.join_code

messages.read: exists chats(id = this.chatId, isPublic = true) or exists chatMembers(chatId = this.chatId, userId = session.identity.subject)
